title: Product Manual for Protective Helmets According to IS 4151:2015
purpose: Guidelines for certification of Two-Wheeler Protective Helmets under Scheme I (ISI Mark).

operational_guidelines.sampling_guidelines: Helmets drawn across shell sizes and visor variants for conditioning (ambient, heat, cold, and water immersion) and impact testing.
operational_guidelines.scheme_of_inspection_and_testing: Routine quality tests must include impact absorption test, retention system dynamic test, and visor light transmittance.
primary_test_equipment_required: Guided fall impact drop apparatus with modular headforms (sizes A, E, J, M, O)
Triaxial accelerometer measurement system (peak acceleration <= 300 g)
Retention test apparatus with 30 kg dynamic falling mass
Visor luminous transmittance and refractive power spectrophotometer
